correctness.rationale: Lagrange evaluation gives independent uniform f(x). Joint missing-value events have q identical pairs for each difference c, with one or two excluded outputs per x. Summation establishes the covariance exactly. The positive discrete second differences of a^t b^(q-t), including q=2 boundary, establish strict Schur-convexity, exact unique minimum and maximum, and two sharp next-profile gaps. Sign proof uses log(1-z^-2)<-z^-2 and log(1+z^-1)<z^-1. Exact exhaustive tests of all f,h for q=2,3,4 and selected q=5 cases independently confirm.

value.rationale: The marginal value-set law motivates the natural joint-dependence question for f and its shared-sample perturbation. Exact formula for every h is an infinite-field classification and structural Schur-convex ordering of all collision profiles; permutation and constant perturbations have opposite covariance signs, and next-best profiles have exact strictly positive gaps. These are not merely re-tabulations of a single-polynomial distribution.
